recommendations.title: Missing H1 Tags
recommendations.recommendation: Every page should have exactly one H1 tag that describes the main topic

recommendations.title: Low ORB Semantic Space Score
recommendations.description: 2 pages cover less than 65% of their expected semantic space
recommendations.recommendation: Add missing entities, questions, supporting subtopics, and schema-aligned language

recommendations.title: Thin Content
recommendations.recommendation: Expand thin pages with comprehensive, valuable content

recommendations.title: Weak Semantic Coverage
recommendations.description: 4 pages have shallow topical depth or low semantic coverage
recommendations.recommendation: Expand pages around the primary topic, related entities, questions, and supporting subtopics

recommendations.title: Title Tag Issues
recommendations.description: 4 pages have missing, too long, or too short title tags
recommendations.recommendation: Ensure every page has a unique title tag between 10-60 characters

recommendations.title: Meta Description Issues
recommendations.description: 6 pages have missing or poorly optimized meta descriptions
recommendations.recommendation: Write compelling meta descriptions between 50-160 characters

recommendations.title: Missing Canonical Tags
recommendations.recommendation: Add canonical tags to prevent duplicate content issues

recommendations.title: Weak Internal Link Distribution
recommendations.description: 2 pages have fewer than two internal outgoing links
recommendations.recommendation: Add contextual internal links to relevant service, category, and supporting content pages

recommendations.title: Images Missing Alt Text
recommendations.description: 25 pages have images without alt text
recommendations.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to all images for accessibility and SEO
